sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Pluralsight's PairIP / Play licence verification (including its custom-trial re-check) so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Launch gate only — subscriptions and course access are validated by Pluralsight's servers.
Disables Heap's two auto-init ContentProviders (behavioural session recording) and sets the Firebase analytics collection opt-outs. FCM push and remote config are kept.

No-ops Pluralsight's own Firebase Analytics event sink (pa1.a), so no usage event and no analytics user-id is sent. SDK components are disabled by 'Disable tracker components'. Mux video analytics is deliberately left alone (see the docs):…
